note: The thin adapter for the ai-harness insight-desk skill (Ruling, Krish, 2026-11-24). The method is the skill, read live with get_skill; until it is admitted, from a local ai-harness checkout's candidates/insight-desk, else the desk is recorded as unavailable and this engine runs as before. Nothing here posts, sends or spends.

humour.rule: never assumed: only where Krish's approved taste for mindmake allows it does a later change set this true; no humour engine call and no comedy method otherwise

divergent.command: npm run divergent -- score --lane ideas --problem TEXT --ideas-file FILE --obvious-file FILE

thesis.line: AI makes strong judgement stronger and weak judgement weaker. Mindmake builds the strong kind.

approval: stage plan behind strategy, through the daily dispatch's proposal path; approving an idea approves a plan only
hand_off: the approved idea's claim, as the optional angle for src/stages/openings.mjs (angleFromSheet in src/lib/insight-sheet.mjs); every draft keeps its own gate
cadence: at most one sheet a week
